notes: NEW subject pack: Finance Basics — compound interest, simple interest, the 50/30/20 budget rule, credit and APR, inflation and real returns, diversification and risk, emergency fund, and avalanche vs snowball debt payoff, with which-idea, compound-interest, simple-interest, and rule-of-72 practice, never your assignment.

NEW in the detector results: when the overall verdict and the sentence view disagree — for example the overall score reads AI but the sentences mostly read human, or the other way round — the results now say so plainly in a flagbox and call the result a weak signal to check by reading the writing yourself, not proof. A score is a signal to review, never proof of authorship.

Detector V42 was trained and measured this run but HELD, not shipped: on the permanent frozen probe it caught 14 of 18 humanized texts, below the shipped V36's 16 — and its human false-flag rate ticked up slightly to 4.87% (from 4.66%), so V36 stays live until a round genuinely beats it. This round tested the leading idea from last time — a bigger set of Qwen-written humanized texts (80 fresh docs, 140 in the pool) — and the answer is mixed: the new Qwen probe went to 12 of 12 and neural-paraphrase detection rose to 60.9%, but the frozen probe lost two texts (beekeeping, vertical farming) and the human personal-essay false flag deepened to 99.5%. Next try: quality over quantity — a stronger generator for the humanized class — and revisiting how the stylometric specialist is combined.
